passage:
M: The fruit drink is almost ready. I was going to sweeten the whole pitcher before we leave.
F: Could you pour some into a second bottle before adding the sugar? Dana likes it plain. Give her the bottle with the smooth lid. The lid on the other bottle has ridges.
M: I can tie a paper tag around the plain one. That might make it easier to see which is which.
F: The bottles will sit in ice water. The paper label won’t stay on. Leave both bottles closed until everyone gets there.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The fruit drink is almost ready. I was going to sweeten the whole pitcher before we leave.
turns.zh: 水果飲料快好了。我原想出發前把整壺都加糖。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Could you pour some into a second bottle before adding the sugar? Dana likes it plain. Give her the bottle with the smooth lid. The lid on the other bottle has ridges.
turns.zh: 可以先倒一些到第二個瓶子，再加糖嗎？黛娜喜歡不加糖的。把瓶蓋光滑那瓶給她。另一瓶的蓋子有凸紋。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can tie a paper tag around the plain one. That might make it easier to see which is which.
turns.zh: 我可以在不加糖那瓶綁紙標籤，這樣可能比較好分辨。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The bottles will sit in ice water. The paper label won’t stay on. Leave both bottles closed until everyone gets there.
turns.zh: 瓶子會泡在冰水裡，紙標籤會掉下來。兩瓶都要等大家到齊才開。

title: Questions 35–37

standaloneStems: Number 35. Why does the woman ask for two bottles?
Number 36. Why does the woman reject the man’s suggestion for identifying a bottle?
Number 37. How should Dana identify her bottle before anyone opens it?
